description: This file contains unit tests for the failover policy functions 'resolveRunFailoverDecision' and 'mergeRetryFailoverReason', using the Vitest testing framework. It tests various scenarios for decision making during failover situations in a system, including retry limits, profile rotation, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: resolveRunFailoverDecision
methods.description: Determines the action to take based on the failover context, including whether to fallback, rotate profile, or continue normally.

methods.name: mergeRetryFailoverReason
methods.description: Merges previous and current failover reasons, prioritizing timeout and preserving previous reasons when current is null.
